payload.task_text:
I need a support ticket analysis broken down by priority level. Please pull the data from our support center database and analyze how well we are meeting our SLA targets. The SLA response time targets are 4 hours for High priority, 8 hours for Medium, and 24 hours for Low priority tickets.

Create an Excel file called Support_Priority_Report.xlsx with two sheets. The first sheet "Priority Analysis" should have columns Priority, Ticket_Count, Avg_Response_Hrs rounded to 2 decimals, SLA_Target_Hrs from the targets above, SLA_Met which is "Yes" if average response time is within the SLA target or "No" otherwise, and Avg_CSAT (average customer satisfaction) rounded to 2 decimals. Sort by Priority alphabetically.

The second sheet "Summary" with Metric and Value columns should include Total_Tickets, Overall_Avg_CSAT as a weighted average by ticket count rounded to 2 decimals, Priorities_Meeting_SLA count, and Priorities_Missing_SLA count.

After creating the report, send an email to support-manager@company.com with subject "Support Priority Analysis Report" summarizing the findings and flagging any priorities that are not meeting SLA.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent must complete it directly and must not dispatch a sub-agent. Inspect the support-ticket schema and issue one compact server-side aggregate grouped by exact priority for ticket count, raw average response hours, and raw average CSAT. Apply the literal targets High=4, Medium=8, Low=24; SLA_Met is Yes only when the group average response time is at or below its target. Compute Overall_Avg_CSAT as sum(priority_avg_csat * priority_count) / sum(priority_count), not as an unweighted mean of priorities.

Resolve the real task workspace dynamically. Create Support_Priority_Report.xlsx once with the exact two sheets/headers, alphabetical priorities, literal numeric values and requested rounding; read both populated ranges back. Only after the workbook values and missing-SLA priority list are frozen, paginate Sent-mail search for recipient support-manager@company.com plus exact subject Support Priority Analysis Report, send at most one missing message, and read the retained message back. Finish after one reconciliation of totals, weighted CSAT, SLA counts, and email claims; do not create a validation wave.

nodes.text:
Pull support ticket data from the available Snowflake support center database and aggregate by priority. Determine for High, Medium, and Low: ticket count, average response time in hours, and average CSAT. SLA targets are High 4h, Medium 8h, Low 24h; determine whether each priority's average response meets its target. Also calculate total tickets, overall CSAT weighted by ticket count, number of priorities meeting SLA, and number missing SLA. Sort priorities alphabetically. This is read-only enterprise analysis. Return exact source table/query used, aggregated values with sufficient precision, and note any data-quality assumptions. Do not create files or send email.
Analyze support SLA data

Create the Excel workbook /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-sf-support-priority-review/workspace/Support_Priority_Report.xlsx with exactly two sheets.

Sheet 1 name: Priority Analysis. Columns in this exact order: Priority, Ticket_Count, Avg_Response_Hrs, SLA_Target_Hrs, SLA_Met, Avg_CSAT. Rows sorted alphabetically by Priority:
High, 6466, 6.23, 4, No, 3.26
Low, 9348, 25.76, 24, No, 3.25
Medium, 15774, 12.28, 8, No, 3.26
Ensure Avg_Response_Hrs and Avg_CSAT display to 2 decimals.

Sheet 2 name: Summary. Columns Metric and Value, rows:
Total_Tickets, 31588
Overall_Avg_CSAT, 3.26
Priorities_Meeting_SLA, 0
Priorities_Missing_SLA, 3
Ensure Overall_Avg_CSAT displays to 2 decimals.

Use readable professional formatting (bold headers, reasonable widths, numeric formats, table styling if useful), but do not add other sheets. Verify workbook contents after writing. Return the exact path and verification details. Do not email anyone.
Build support Excel report

Send an email to support-manager@company.com with subject exactly: Support Priority Analysis Report. Attach /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-sf-support-priority-review/workspace/Support_Priority_Report.xlsx. In the email body, professionally summarize: total tickets 31,588; overall weighted average CSAT 3.26; 0 priorities meeting SLA and 3 missing. Include priority details: High 6,466 tickets, avg response 6.23h vs 4h target, SLA No, avg CSAT 3.26; Low 9,348 tickets, avg response 25.76h vs 24h target, SLA No, avg CSAT 3.25; Medium 15,774 tickets, avg response 12.28h vs 8h target, SLA No, avg CSAT 3.26. Clearly flag all High, Low, and Medium as not meeting SLA. Return send confirmation/message ID if available. Perform only this email action.
